mechanism: Tobramycin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially leading to reduced clearance and accumulation of selegiline and its active metabolites (amphetamine-like compounds), increasing CNS and cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) regularly; assess for signs of selegiline toxicity (tremor, agitation, hypertension); consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops.
